title: Window size overrides force fullscreen if they match screen size
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.rc3

### System information

Godot v4.4.rc3 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700K CPU @ 4.00GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

There are two issues, but they are related.

**First issue (minor)**
Setting initial position and window size overrides in the project settings mean completely different things for windowed and fullscreen modes
- For windowed mode it means position/size of the actual content, without decorations
- For fullscreen mode, if we start in this mode and call `DisplayServer.window_set_mode(DisplayServer.WINDOW_MODE_WINDOWED)`, the initial position and size overrides will mean position and size of the decorated window

**Second issue**
Setting window size overrides to a size of a screen will force the window into fullscreen visually. So if we have position 0,0 and size 500,500, leaving fullscreen into windowed will position window placing decorations at 0,0 and the whole window will be 500,500 (this is expected). But if we set initial position to 0,0 and size overrides to 1920,1080 (given that's your resolution), the window will go into fullscreen and will not have any decorations. Moreover, if the position is 200,200 (or any other), the window will move into 200,200 and will not have any decorations.

### Steps to reproduce

N/A

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Edit: MRP added
When reproducing this, please make sure window size overrides match your primary screen size.
Viewport is quite random, to make sure it doesn't matter for the reproduction, but you still should see the button on your screen, as there is no automatic resize.
